description: This file defines the AdHocReadPlatformService interface, which provides methods for retrieving ad-hoc query data in the Fineract platform.

classes.name: AdHocReadPlatformService
classes.description: An interface that declares methods for fetching ad-hoc query data, both in list form and individual items.

methods.name: retrieveAllAdHocQuery
methods.description: Returns a list of all ad-hoc queries.

methods.name: retrieveAllActiveAdHocQuery
methods.description: Returns a list of all active ad-hoc queries.

methods.name: retrieveOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific ad-hoc query by its ID.

methods.name: retrieveNewAdHocDetails
methods.description: Provides details for creating a new ad-hoc query.
